# Base Daily Brief

Base Daily Brief is a daily curated bulletin from the Base ecosystem, gated by the x402 payment protocol on Base Mainnet.

## API Endpoints

### Get Bulletin
GET https://basedailybrief.vercel.app/api/bulletins/{date}?locale=en
- Payment: $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base Mainnet
- Returns: JSON bulletin with title, summary, and full content
- Dates: YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-09-01)
- Locale: en (English) or tr (Turkish)

### List Bulletins
GET https://basedailybrief.vercel.app/api/bulletins
- Payment: Free
- Returns: List of available bulletins with dates and summaries

### Subscribe (30 days)
POST https://basedailybrief.vercel.app/api/subscribe
- Payment: $0.25 USDC via x402 on Base Mainnet
- Returns: API key valid for 30 days
- Usage: Add X-API-Key header to bulletin requests

### Tokenized Stocks Data
GET https://basedailybrief.vercel.app/api/stocks
- Payment: $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base Mainnet
- Returns: Live onchain data for NVDAc, METAc, AAPLc, GOOGLc

### MCP Server
URL: https://basedailybrief.vercel.app/mcp
- Tools: list_bulletins, get_latest_bulletin, get_bulletin, subscribe
- Compatible with Claude and any MCP-enabled agent

## Payment Details
- Protocol: x402
- Network: Base Mainnet (eip155:8453)
- Asset: USDC
- payTo: 0x33661B8496075c3b8b2B69CB3E03BC3436808d78
- Builder Code: bc_2iax4m4l (ERC-8021)

## Example Usage (Base MCP)
"Call this x402 endpoint and pay up to 0.01 USDC: https://basedailybrief.vercel.app/api/bulletins/2026-09-01?locale=en"

## Agent Card
https://basedailybrief.vercel.app/.well-known/agent-card.json

## OpenAPI
https://basedailybrief.vercel.app/openapi.json

## About
- Publisher: coinacci
- Updated: Daily (14:00-15:00 Turkey time)
- Not financial advice
